originals.ko: 그들은 길을 이끌고 싶어해 하지만 그들은 ~ㄹ 필요가 없어
originals.why: MOVED: the Welsh has no 'dydyn nhw ddim isio'. It uses the angen LEGO and practises a different chunk, so it does not belong in this basket.

topups.why: Fixed the Korean: '오늘 저녁 먹고' also reads as 'eat tonight's dinner'. With 에 it can only mean 'tonight'.

originals.ko: 우리는 오늘 저녁에 죽을 수 있을 텐데
미안해 하지만 나는 죽는 게 무서워
originals.why: Here 'mae arna i ofn' means real fear ('afraid to die'), not the regret sense of the gloss 유감이지만. Using 유감이지만 would make nonsense, so the Korean follows the source English. Worth Kai checking the gloss for this sense.
